recipes.name: Fish Sticks
recipes.desc: Five golden panko-crusted fish sticks with tartar dip and a lemon wedge. The fish volunteered. (It didn't. But it's a cartoon fish.)
steps: Cut ING_FISH_FILLET into 5 sticks; wedge ING_LEMON.
Coat ING_FISH_FILLET sticks in ING_FLOUR, ING_EGG and ING_PANKO; fry and shake once.
Plate with ING_TARTAR_SAUCE and the lemon wedge.
cx: Four sticks. I can count to five, you know.
The breading fell off. Now it's just a naked fish.
recipes.look: Five rectangular golden sticks fanned on a plate with a tartar cup and a lemon wedge.
recipes.anim: Sticks stack themselves into a little log pile on serve (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Golden crunch sparkles.
recipes.mut: `claw` parts cut sticks faster (Pincer Prep); Sea Legs adds burn grace on the fry; `MUT_009` Fish Head customers stay quiet about it (bark).

recipes.name: Fried Shrimp Basket
recipes.desc: Three crispy battered shrimp on a bed of fries with tartar sauce, served in a paper basket that is legally not a boat.
steps: Batter and fry ING_SHRIMP with ING_FLOUR and ING_EGG; shake once.
Fry the ING_POTATO fries; shake once.
Basket: ING_POTATO fries, ING_SHRIMP on top, ING_TARTAR_SAUCE cup.
cx: Only three shrimp? Shrimp come in fours. It's science.
My fries are crispier than my shrimp. Hierarchy is broken.
recipes.look: Red-checked paper basket with golden fries and three curled battered shrimp.
recipes.anim: Shrimp curl tighter as the customer reaches for them (prop morph).
recipes.vfx: Crunch sparkles; small steam wisps.
recipes.mut: Sea Legs on the shrimp fry; `MUT_144` Crab Claw Arm customers eye the shrimp suspiciously (bark).

recipes.name: Sushi Roll Block
recipes.desc: Steamed fish, cucumber, avocado and cream cheese rolled in rice and seaweed, cut into six perfect cubes. Robot Accountants weep at the right angles.
steps: Steam ING_FISH_FILLET on the second tray (fully cooked, kid-friendly).
Slice ING_FISH_FILLET, ING_CUCUMBER and ING_AVOCADO into strips.
ING_SEAWEED, ING_RICE, ING_FISH_FILLET, ING_CUCUMBER, ING_AVOCADO, ING_CREAM_CHEESE; roll square.
Cut the roll into 6 cubes (Square Cut, 6 taps).
Plate in a neat grid with ING_SOY_SAUCE.
cx: One cube is a rectangle. I can feel it.
Square sushi? Sushi has always been round. Except now.
recipes.look: Six perfect square sushi blocks in a 2×3 grid with green, orange and white centres and a soy dish.
recipes.anim: Blocks click into alignment on the plate (prop snap tween).
recipes.vfx: Tidy grid sparkle sweep.
recipes.mut: Steam Team speeds both trays; `claw` parts cut the fish faster; `MUT_022` Robot Head customers approve with a beep (bark).

recipes.name: Lobster-ish Roll
recipes.desc: Lobster-ish chunks tossed in lemony mayo with crunchy celery, piled into a butter-toasted Long Boi Bun. It's probably lobster. The tub says 'probably'.
steps: Plate with a paper lobster bib.
cx: Is it lobster or not? I need closure.
Too much -ish. Not enough lobster.
recipes.look: A split-top golden bun overflowing with pink-and-white chunks, celery flecks and a lemon slice.
recipes.anim: Customer wears the paper bib (prop attach) before ANM_043.
recipes.vfx: Butter shimmer; a tiny '?' floats above the filling.
recipes.mut: `MUT_152` Lobster Crusher Arm customers have Questions (bark); Steam Team on the boil; Spark Blend on the toss.

recipes.name: Waving Calamari Rings
recipes.desc: Squishy tentacle sliced into rings, battered and fried golden. Each ring does a tiny wave before you eat it. It's rude not to wave back.
steps: Slice ING_TENTACLE into 8 rings; wedge ING_LEMON.
Coat ING_TENTACLE rings in ING_FLOUR, ING_EGG and ING_PANKO; fry and shake once.
Plate in a ring with ING_TARTAR_SAUCE and the lemon.
cx: Only seven waved. One ring is clearly shy.
It waved goodbye. Before I even ate it. Hurtful.
recipes.look: Golden rings piled on a plate, each with a little wiggly tentacle tip, lemon and tartar cup.
recipes.anim: Rings wave in a Mexican-wave sequence when served (prop bones).
recipes.vfx: Tiny 'hi!' bubbles over the rings.
recipes.mut: Tentacle parts get a 'cousin' bark; `claw` parts slice rings faster (Pincer Prep); Sea Legs on the fry.

recipes.name: Crab Cake Kerfuffle
recipes.desc: Crab cakes so packed with Kerfuffle Crab Meat that they bicker on the plate about who's crispier. Mayo calms them down.
steps: Mince ING_CELERY and ING_HERBS; wedge ING_LEMON.
Cake mix: ING_CRAB_MEAT, ING_EGG, ING_PANKO, ING_CELERY, ING_HERBS.
Fry the ING_CRAB_MEAT cakes (bound with ING_EGG and ING_PANKO); shake once.
Plate two cakes apart (they argue) with ING_MAYO and lemon.
cx: That's my cousin Gary!
The cakes stopped arguing. Now it's awkward.
recipes.look: Two golden crab cakes with crisp edges, a dollop of mayo between them like a referee, lemon wedge.
recipes.anim: Cakes hop toward each other then back (prop tween) as if squabbling.
recipes.vfx: Comic squiggle 'argument' lines between the cakes.
recipes.mut: `MUT_127` Crab Shell Torso and `MUT_144` Crab Claw Arm customers refuse it, with a polite bow (bark); Spark Blend on the mix.

recipes.name: Fish That's Still Looking At You
recipes.desc: A whole roasted Staring Fish on roast potatoes with garlic-herb butter. Its gummy googly eyes follow you everywhere. Eat fast; it judges slow eaters.
steps: Cube ING_POTATO; mince ING_GARLIC and ING_HERBS; slice ING_LEMON.
Tray: ING_POTATO bed, ING_STARE_FISH, ING_BUTTER, ING_GARLIC, ING_HERBS.
Roast ING_STARE_FISH with ING_BUTTER, ING_GARLIC and ING_HERBS on MED.
Plate with lemon slices; eyes facing the customer.
cx: It's NOT looking at me. It's looking at HIM.
It blinked first. I win. I'm still eating it.
recipes.look: Whole cartoon fish, golden-roasted, with big gummy googly eyes, on a bed of crispy potato cubes and lemon slices.
recipes.anim: Googly eyes track the nearest player (client look-at) and wobble when the plate moves.
recipes.vfx: Comic 'stare' lines for 2 s; herb-butter shimmer.
recipes.mut: `MUT_071` Googly Eyes chefs start a staring contest (bark); Kitchen Pro on both roasts; Sea Legs on the fish.

recipes.name: Jellyfish Jiggle Bowl
recipes.desc: Steamed rice bowl topped with steamed tentacle and shrimp, cool cucumber and chilled jellyfish gummies that jiggle with every heartbeat of the restaurant.
steps: Steam ING_TENTACLE and ING_SHRIMP on the second tray.
Chill ING_JELLYFISH_GUMMY and ING_SLIME_JELLY until jiggly (6 s).
Bowl: ING_RICE, ING_SEAWEED, ING_CUCUMBER, ING_SHRIMP, ING_TENTACLE, ING_SLIME_JELLY, ING_JELLYFISH_GUMMY, ING_SOY_SAUCE.
cx: The jiggle is out of sync with the music.
Not enough jiggle. I want a JIGGLE, not a wobble.
recipes.look: Rice bowl topped with translucent pink jellyfish gummies, purple tentacle slices, pink shrimp and green cucumber.
recipes.anim: Jellies jiggle in time with the restaurant music (client beat sync, cosmetic).
recipes.vfx: Soft pink bubbles and jiggle sparkles.
recipes.mut: Cold Snap / `ABL_067` Freeze Touch chills the jellies instantly; `MUT_130` Jellyfish Body customers find it 'a bit much' (bark).

recipes.name: Sea Monster Steak
recipes.desc: A teal-marbled kelp-and-cod steak shaped like a friendly sea monster, crosshatch-grilled and bathed in garlic butter, with chunky fries.
steps: Cut ING_POTATO into chunky fries; mince ING_GARLIC and ING_HERBS; wedge ING_LEMON.
Grill ING_SEA_MONSTER_STEAK; flip and turn for crosshatch marks.
Garlic butter: sauté ING_GARLIC in ING_BUTTER.
Plate the steak, pour the butter, scatter ING_HERBS, fries on the side.
cx: It's a sea MONSTER. Why is it smiling?
No crosshatch? I want a tic-tac-toe board on my steak.
recipes.look: A wavy teal-and-white steak with little fin bumps and crosshatch grill marks, golden butter pooling, chunky fries.
recipes.anim: The steak's little fin flaps once on serve (prop bone).
recipes.vfx: Grill-mark glints; butter shimmer.
recipes.mut: Sea Legs + Hot Hands on the grill; `MUT_038` Kraken Head customers ask if it's a relative (bark).

recipes.name: Kraken Platter
recipes.desc: A grilled Kraken Tentacle the length of the table, surrounded by fried shrimp, fish, calamari rings and fries. It waves at the whole restaurant. The whole restaurant waves back.
steps: Cut ING_FISH_FILLET into strips, ING_TENTACLE into rings, ING_POTATO into fries; wedge ING_LEMON.
Grill the ING_KRAKEN_TENTACLE across both slots; flip once.
Round 1: batter and fry ING_SHRIMP and ING_TENTACLE rings with ING_FLOUR and ING_EGG.
Round 2: batter and fry ING_FISH_FILLET strips with ING_FLOUR and ING_EGG.
Round 3: fry ING_POTATO; skim the oil first if it's Hot.
Platter: ING_KRAKEN_TENTACLE centrepiece, ING_SHRIMP, ING_FISH_FILLET, ING_TENTACLE rings, ING_POTATO, ING_TARTAR_SAUCE cups, ING_LEMON.
Plate on the giant platter; two hands.
cx: The kraken waved at the OTHER table first.
Not enough platter for this much kraken.
recipes.look: A huge violet tentacle with gold-rimmed suckers arcing over a platter of golden fried seafood and fries.
recipes.anim: The kraken tentacle waves slowly over the table (prop bones); parties do a group wave (ANM_042 synced).
recipes.vfx: Bubble trail and gold sucker glints.
recipes.mut: `MUT_165` Kraken Tentacle Arm (`ABL_060` is combat-only) and `MUT_137` Kraken Core chefs earn a regal bark and Many Hands on the platter; Sea Legs on every fry.

recipes.name: Garden Salad
recipes.desc: Lettuce, tomato and cucumber tossed with ranch. Fresh, crunchy and completely unbothered by everything happening around it.
steps: Toss ING_LETTUCE, ING_TOMATO, ING_CUCUMBER with ING_RANCH in the bowl.
cx: It's... a salad. I was hoping for chaos.
The cucumber is wearing sunglasses. Why?
recipes.look: Bowl of green lettuce frills with red tomato wedges, cucumber coins and a ranch drizzle.
recipes.anim: Leaves toss themselves once in the bowl (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Fresh green sparkle.
recipes.mut: Green Thumb (`MUT_093` Leaf Ears, `MUT_177` Leaf Hands) widens all chop zones; Health Nut customers tip happily.

recipes.name: Caesar Salad With Tiny Crown
recipes.desc: Romaine-style lettuce, grilled chicken, parmesan and royal dressing, finished with a crouton carved into a tiny crown. All hail the salad.
steps: Chop ING_LETTUCE, slice the grilled ING_CHICKEN, shave ING_PARMESAN, carve ING_CROUTON into a crown.
Bowl: ING_LETTUCE, ING_CHICKEN, ING_CAESAR_DRESSING, ING_PARMESAN, ING_CROUTON crown on top.
cx: The crown is crooked. This salad cannot rule.
The crown is too small. I'm a BIG customer.
recipes.look: Bowl of green leaves with chicken slices and parmesan curls, topped by a golden crouton shaped like a tiny crown.
recipes.anim: The crouton crown tips its 'hat' (tilts) when served.
recipes.vfx: Tiny regal sparkle and a 'ta-da' trumpet note (audio only).
recipes.mut: `MUT_047` Mustache of Destiny customers bow to it (bark); Kitchen Pro on the chicken; `claw` parts slice the chicken faster.

recipes.name: Fruit Salad Explosion
recipes.desc: Six fruits chopped into a rainbow and folded into blueberry yogurt, served with a confetti popper that 'explodes' the salad into the bowl. Very vitamin. Very loud.
steps: Halve ING_GRAPE, slice ING_STRAWBERRY, dice ING_APPLE.
Bowl: ING_WATERMELON, ING_PINEAPPLE, ING_GRAPE, ING_STRAWBERRY, ING_APPLE, ING_YOGURT dressing.
cx: It didn't explode. It merely sat there being fruit.
Too explosive. A grape hit my eye. Gently.
recipes.look: A rainbow bowl of fruit cubes with a purple yogurt swirl and a paper confetti popper stuck in the top.
recipes.anim: Customer pulls the popper (hand prop) — fruit 'jumps' 0.3 studs in the bowl and lands back.
recipes.vfx: Kid-safe confetti burst and comic 'POP!'.
recipes.mut: Green Thumb on both chop steps; Sweet Tooth on the mix; `MUT_063` Toucan Beak customers order two (bark).

recipes.name: Salad With No Lettuce
recipes.desc: Spinach, purple cabbage, cucumber, tomato, carrot, avocado, croutons and candied nuts. Every green except THE green. Lettuce has been notified.
steps: Slice ING_CUCUMBER, ING_TOMATO, ING_CARROT and ING_AVOCADO.
Crumble ING_CROUTON into tiny cubes (Tiny Chop).
Bowl: ING_SPINACH, ING_PURPLE_CABBAGE, ING_CUCUMBER, ING_TOMATO, ING_CARROT, ING_AVOCADO, ING_CROUTON, ING_CANDIED_NUTS, ING_RANCH.
cx: I found a lettuce molecule. One. I have sensitive leaves.
Where's the lettuce? Oh. Right. Hmm.
recipes.look: Bowl of dark greens and violet cabbage with orange, red and green confetti, croutons and glossy nuts — no pale lettuce anywhere.
recipes.anim: A tiny 'NO LETTUCE' flag pops up from the bowl (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Leafy sparkle; a lettuce-crossed-out glyph flashes once.
recipes.mut: Green Thumb on all chops; Spinach-loving `MUT_030` Broccoli Head customers nod approvingly (bark).

recipes.name: Carnivore "Salad"
recipes.desc: Bacon, ham, turkey, grilled chicken, a crumbled patty and meatballs tossed in ranch, with exactly one lettuce leaf 'for legal reasons'. The quotation marks are load-bearing.
steps: Grill ING_CHICKEN and ING_BEEF_PATTY side by side; flip each once.
Slice ING_HAM, ING_TURKEY and the grilled ING_CHICKEN; crumble ING_BEEF_PATTY.
Bowl: ING_LETTUCE leaf, ING_HAM, ING_TURKEY, ING_CHICKEN, ING_BEEF_PATTY, ING_MEATBALL, ING_BACON, ING_RANCH.
cx: There's a lettuce leaf in my salad. Unacceptable.
Only six meats? It's basically a garden.
recipes.look: Bowl heaped with assorted meats, a ranch drizzle and a single lonely lettuce leaf on top like a flag.
recipes.anim: The lonely lettuce leaf droops sadly when the customer flicks it off (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Tiny 'legally a salad' stamp decal flashes on serve.
recipes.mut: `ABL_061` Extra Hands runs fryer, grill and pan together; `claw` parts slice the meats faster (Pincer Prep).

recipes.name: French Fries
recipes.desc: Thirty golden fries in a paper box with a ketchup cup. The most-ordered side in Morph City, and the most-stolen off other people's plates.
steps: Cut ING_POTATO into fries (4 taps each).
Box them with a ING_KETCHUP cup.
cx: Twenty-nine fries. I counted. Twice.
Soggy! A fry must CRUNCH.
recipes.look: Red-and-white paper box overflowing with golden fries and a small ketchup cup.
recipes.anim: One fry hops out of the box when served (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Salt-sparkle twinkles.
recipes.mut: The canon starter side. Hot Hands shortens the fry; countable for 'exactly N fries' COUNT mods (§5.4.9).

recipes.name: Onion Rings
recipes.desc: Thick onion rings in crunchy batter with a mustard dip. Each ring is a tiny edible halo for a very greasy angel.
steps: Dip ING_ONION rings in the ING_FLOUR and ING_EGG batter; fry and shake once.
Stack the rings on a stick with a ING_MUSTARD cup.
cx: This ring is an oval. I can't wear it as a crown.
My breath now smells like a decision I regret.
recipes.look: A stack of golden rings on a wooden skewer with a yellow mustard cup.
recipes.anim: Customer wears one ring as a monocle before eating it (prop attach).
recipes.vfx: Crunch sparkles; cartoon tear-drop on the chopping step.
recipes.mut: `MUT_051` Clown Nose customers wear one (bark); Hot Hands on the fry.

recipes.name: Fried Pickles
recipes.desc: Nine pickle chips in crunchy batter with ranch. Sour, salty, crispy — like a pickle that went to finishing school.
steps: Batter ING_PICKLE chips in ING_FLOUR and ING_EGG; fry and shake once.
cx: Eight chips. Where's number nine? I named it.
Too crispy — I can't taste the pickle's personality.
recipes.look: Basket of golden round chips with green edges peeking out, ranch cup.
recipes.anim: Chips sizzle-hop on the plate for 1 s (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Green brine sparkle inside golden crunch sparkles.
recipes.mut: Countable for COUNT mods (9 slices default); `ABL_064` Super Sniff reveals hidden pickle-count mods.

recipes.name: Fried Ice Cream
recipes.desc: Two hard-frozen scoops rolled in egg wash and cereal, flash-fried for three seconds and drizzled with caramel. Hot outside, cold inside, confused all over.
steps: Scoop two tight balls of ING_ICE_CREAM_BASE.
Roll ING_ICE_CREAM_BASE in the ING_EGG wash and ING_CEREAL; flash-fry — the window is only 1 s!
Melt ING_CHOCOLATE into a warm sauce.
Plate with ING_CHOCOLATE sauce, ING_CARAMEL drizzle, ING_WHIPPED_CREAM and a ING_CHERRY.
cx: It melted inside. That's just fried soup.
Too cold inside. Is that the point? I'm conflicted.
recipes.look: Two golden crunchy spheres in a bowl of chocolate and caramel, cream swirl and a cherry, wisps of both steam and frost.
recipes.anim: Customer's face flips between 'hot' and 'cold' expressions (face swap) on the first bite.
recipes.vfx: Simultaneous steam and frost particles.
recipes.mut: `ABL_067` Freeze Touch replaces the freezer step; `ABL_066` Microwave Zap-Cook is a lifesaver on the 1 s fry window (GOOD, no Perfect Plate).

recipes.name: Fried Everything Basket
recipes.desc: Fries, onion rings, pickles, shrimp, chicken, mozzarella sticks, calamari and candy Bug Crunch — all battered, all fried, all in one heroic basket. The fryer needs a holiday afterwards.
steps: Cut ING_POTATO, ING_ONION, ING_PICKLE, ING_CHICKEN, ING_MOZZARELLA and ING_TENTACLE into bite pieces.
Round 2: batter ING_SHRIMP, ING_TENTACLE and ING_ONION in ING_FLOUR and ING_EGG; fry.
Round 3: batter ING_CHICKEN, ING_PICKLE and ING_MOZZARELLA; fry (skim first if Hot).
Round 4: flash-fry ING_BUG_CRUNCH for a candy crackle.
Basket: ING_POTATO, ING_ONION, ING_PICKLE, ING_SHRIMP, ING_CHICKEN, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_TENTACLE, ING_BUG_CRUNCH, ING_KETCHUP and ING_RANCH cups.
cx: You missed one thing. You didn't fry the basket.
Everything? Where's the fried ice cream? EVERYTHING means EVERYTHING.
recipes.look: An overflowing basket with a golden mountain of assorted fried shapes, two dip cups and candy beetles on top.
recipes.anim: Basket overflows a little when set down (a few pieces tumble back in, prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Golden crunch sparkles and a comic 'FRY-UMPH!' text.
recipes.mut: The ultimate OilHeat juggling test (§5.4.4): `water` parts help extinguish, Hot Hands shortens every round, `ABL_061` Extra Hands lets you chop while frying.
